verbatim: Ruling, no amendment needed: the declared instrument IS the survival fit — all four endpoints jointly with the one shared width (and ρ for the curvature rival), the active pose's shadow held in the forward model as predicted (never refitted), γ present only on the active endpoints. "Receded first" in clause 7 is the order of identification, reporting and gating, not a staged optimizer: (1) report the receded endpoints' survival first and separately, on receded bins only; a stroke whose receded endpoints fail has failed, whatever the active endpoints do; (2) then report the active endpoints beneath the held shadow with the shadow-only control bins. Because the only cross-pose coupling in the declared family is the shared width, add one DIAGNOSTIC reading, labelled so and not a survival test: run the same fitter on the inactive observations alone (active coordinates unconstrained, dropped from the report) and table its width and ρ beside the joint fit's; a difference above the resolution is a finding that the active data pulls the width, reported in §5.192. No frozen-coordinate API, no new schedule, no new budget; the declared starts and budgets apply to both runs. Tell the G1 owner; proceed when steps 2–3 signal.
